verdict.rationale: Datalab offers a free-tier Forge playground and a monthly usage allowance explicitly framed for running a 'proof of concept' without a credit card, letting users try conversions before committing to production workflows (datalab-docs-9, datalab-docs-10, datalab-docs-23, datalab-docs-42). However, there is no dedicated 'sandbox environment' concept, no separate test API keys/staging tier, and no mention of isolating test runs from production billing/data pipelines. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging mode, test-vs-production API key separation, and confirmation that sandbox usage doesn't touch production data stores or billing.
